attributes.provenance: src/game/game/pmotion.c::get_player_pos, worktree GDL-Claude-PmotionDr4, commit 89fa74d48. The function carried an eight-word STRUCTURAL frame residual across several sessions: the two fabs-idiom compiler temps sat at 16/20(r1) in ours and 32/36(r1) in the target, a constant 16-byte delta, with EVERY other stack slot (48, 52, 100/104/108, 128/132/136, 140..160, stmw 172, LR 260) already identical on both sides. attempt.get-player-pos-effectpos-and-sigma-bijection.20260831.v2 recorded it as a SEPARATE, INDEPENDENT residual and reported the outgoing-parameter-area theory as falsified; claim.law.frame-bottom-region-is-outgoing-args-not-a-dead-local.20260831.v1 concluded from a sibling function that such a low region can only be an outgoing-argument area. Both readings excluded the true cause. Two probes settled it: (1) an unprototyped K&R redeclaration `s32 try_location();` of the 6-argument callee, which under an AIX-style rule would have reserved 24 bytes, moved the frame bottom by ZERO bytes - the outgoing-argument area stayed 8 - while shrinking the outer pad `u8 unused_8[24]` -> [8] shifted EVERY slot down by exactly 16 and the frame 256 -> 240, confirming the outer pad sits above the temps exactly as the prior law says; (2) restoring the pad shrink and adding `u8 unused_i[16];` immediately after the do-loop's own `f32 d;` put the temps at 32/36, left every other slot untouched, held the frame at 256, and closed all eight words. real 264 -> 248, fuzzy 97.7806% -> 97.7964%, defake_gate GATE OK with no sibling flags, full ninja green, main.dol OK.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: A DEAD REGION AT THE BOTTOM OF THE TARGET FRAME IS NOT NECESSARILY AN OUTGOING-ARGUMENT AREA: IT IS OFTEN UNRECOVERED INNER-BLOCK LOCALS, AND AN INNER-BLOCK PAD REACHES BELOW THE COMPILER TEMPS WHERE AN OUTER-BLOCK PAD CANNOT. This supersedes claim.law.frame-bottom-region-is-outgoing-args-not-a-dead-local.20260831.v1, whose observation is correct but whose disposition is too narrow. MWCC GC 1.2.5 assigns frame offsets to locals in DECLARATION ORDER, downward from the top of the local area, and it does not distinguish outer-block from inner-block locals when doing so - it only visits inner-block declarations later. So the region under the address-taken temps is simply whatever was declared AFTER them, and the prior law's three neutral probes all failed for one reason: every one of them moved an OUTER-block array, which is by construction declared before any inner-block local and therefore can never be placed below one. THE LEVER IS SCOPE, NOT ORDER, ALIGNMENT, OR LIVENESS. Declare the pad inside the SAME inner block as the last compiler temp, textually AFTER that temp's own declaration, and it lands below it. On get_player_pos the target's low 24 bytes decomposed as an 8-byte outgoing-argument area plus 16 bytes of inner-block locals, and the exact reconstruction was `u8 unused_8[24]` -> `u8 unused_8[8]` at outer scope PLUS `u8 unused_i[16];` declared directly after the do-loop's `f32 d;` - the frame stayed 256 and all eight structural words closed at once. MEASURED NEGATIVE CONTROL, WORTH KEEPING: the AIX-style hypothesis that an unprototyped or K&R call reserves 4*nargs of parameter area is FALSE for this compiler. Replacing a 6-argument prototype with `s32 try_location();` changed neither the outgoing-argument area, the frame size, the instruction count, nor the opcode multiset. The outgoing-argument area is sized only by arguments that genuinely do not fit in r3-r10/f1-f8, so on a function whose instruction stream already matches the target the argument area CANNOT be the explanation for a frame delta - extra stack arguments would have to be stored, and stores are instructions. DIAGNOSTIC ORDER, cheap and decisive, for any frame residual: dump every N(r1) displacement from both sides and compare slot-by-slot (not just the frame size). If ALL slots agree except a contiguous low group shifted by a constant, the missing bytes are inner-block locals and the fix is an inner-block pad; only if the instruction counts also differ should the outgoing-argument area be considered at all.
